content.thinking: Bug in ref: `pn.to_bytes(w, 'big')` fails when pn ≥ 2^(8w). Should be `pn % 2^(8w)` low bytes: `(pn & (2**(8*w)-1)).to_bytes(w, 'big')`. Fix ref.

cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('ref.py').read()
src = src.replace("        pnbytes = pn.to_bytes(w, 'big')", "        pnbytes = (pn & (2**(8*w)-1)).to_bytes(w, 'big')")
open('ref.py','w').write(src)
print('ok')

cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
from t import *
import ref, json, wire as W

def check(name, tr, manual=None):
    got = run([tr])['traces'][0]
    exp = ref.audit(tr)
    ok = json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(exp, sort_keys=True)
    print(f"== {name}: ref-match={ok}")
    if manual is not None:
        for k, v in manual.items():
            gv = got
            for part in k.split('.'):
                gv = gv[int(part)] if isinstance(gv, list) else gv[part]
            print(f"   {k} = {gv!r} (want {v!r}) {'OK' if gv == v else 'MISMATCH'}")
    return got

tr = trace([datagram(envelope('I', 0, b'\x01', width=1))], received={'I':127,'H':None,'A':None})
check("pn-tie", tr, {'packets.0.pn': 256, 'packets.0.status':'OK', 'received.I': 256})

wire1 = envelope('A', 0, b'\x01', width=4)
tr = trace([datagram(wire1, auth=[0])], received={'I':None,'H':None,'A':2**62-1})
check("pn-range", tr, {'packets.0.pn': 2**62, 'packets.0.status':'PN_RANGE', 'packets.0.epoch': None, 'received.A': 2**62-1})

body = stream(0, 0, b'abc', fin=False) + b'\x99'
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, body, width=1), auth=[0])])
g = check("rollback-stream", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', 'closed.code':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR',
                                  'closed.offset': 7, 'used': 0, 'streams': []})

body = bytes([0x12]) + W.v(2**60) + bytes([0x13]) + W.v(2**60+1)
tr = trace([dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, body, width=1), auth=[0])])
g = check("maxstreams-boundary", tr, {'packets.0.status':'FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR', 'closed.offset': len(bytes([0x12])+W.v(2**60))})

evs = [dict(keys=['A'])]
evs.append(datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x01', width=1, phase=0), auth=[0]))
evs.append(datagram(envelope('A', 1, b'\x01', width=1, phase=1), auth=[1]))
evs.append(datagram(envelope('A', 2, b'\x01', width=1, phase=1), auth=[2]))
tr = trace(evs)
g = check("epoch-motion", tr, {'key_epoch': 2, 'packets.2.status':'OK', 'packets.2.epoch': 2})
print("   epochs:", g['epochs'])

evs = [dict(keys=['A']),
       datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x01', width=1, phase=1), auth=[1]),
       datagram(envelope('A', 1, b'\x01', width=1, phase=0), auth=[0])]
tr = trace(evs)
g = check("epoch-violation", tr, {'packets.1.status':'KEY_UPDATE_ERROR', 'closed.code':'KEY_UPDATE_ERROR',
                                  'closed.offset': 0, 'received.A': 1, 'key_epoch': 1})
print("   epochs:", g['epochs'])

evs = [dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x01', width=1, phase=1), auth=[0])]
tr = trace(evs)
check("parity", tr, {'packets.0.status':'AUTH', 'packets.0.epoch': None})

evs = [dict(keys=['A']), datagram(envelope('A', 0, b'\x01', width=1, phase=0), auth=[2])]
tr = trace(evs)
check("window", tr, {'packets.0.status':'AUTH'})
